messages:
Marta Chen: FYI GreenPort reseller applied a 20% partner discount on INV-2026-0421 but their contract GP-2025-COMM-10 only allows a 10% margin. Customer asked for correction. @Alec Rivera @Finance Bot
Alec Rivera: Can you paste invoice lines and contract id so I can verify amounts?
Marta Chen: Invoice snip:
INV-2026-0421
- Reserved GPU hours (us-west) 12,000 hrs @ $0.50 = $6,000.00
- Partner discount (applied) 20% = -$1,200.00
- Net billed = $4,800.00
Contract: GP-2025-COMM-10 (committed partner margin = 10%). Customer says they were charged the discounted net instead of our committed billing.
Alec Rivera: With 10% we should have subtracted $600, so net $5,400. Difference = $600. Any other adjustments?
Marta Chen: Partner also applied an onboarding promo (-$50) by mistake. Total credit owed = $650.
Finance Bot: Auto-check flagged promo mismatch. Created ticket FIN-3172. Recommend: issue credit memo $650. GL suggested: 4-2210 (Customer Credits).
Samir Kaur: Iris, can you approve and confirm refund vs credit memo?
Iris Patel: Reviewed GP-2025-COMM-10. Approve credit memo $650. Do not issue cash refund; use credit memo. Also request partner settlement correction on next payout. :white_check_mark:
Alec Rivera: I'll create CM-2026-0783 and route to accounting. Marta, please confirm customer note.
Marta Chen: Proposed note: "We corrected a misapplied reseller discount on invoice INV-2026-0421. A $650 credit memo has been issued to offset the over-applied discount. No action is required on your end." Keeps neutral tone.
Samir Kaur: Running create step:
/create-credit --cust GreenPort --invoice INV-2026-0421 --amt 650 --type credit_memo --reason "reseller promo misapply"
System: CM-2026-0783 created and queued for posting in EOD batch.
Alec Rivera: GL 4-2210 confirmed; partner settlement flagged. Noted in FIN-3172.
Marta Chen: I'll notify customer once posted. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Finance Bot: FIN-3172 updated: CM-2026-0783 issued; payouts queue action assigned to Partner Ops.
